records.japanese: これ以上は船を処分できません！
records.current_English: No more ships can be scrapped!
records.english: You can't sell any more ships!{PAD}
records.source_meaning: No more ships can be disposed of. The sole original ARM caller is the Sell path when its eligible ship list is empty.
records.localization_note: Sell is bound by the observed original caller; scrap described the wrong operation. No last-ship rule is invented: the original list can include docked ships and excludes the admiral's ship.
records.speaker: System, original Sell refusal
records.context: Original Sell branch when the native sellable-list builder returns zero; separate system-modal consumer.
